headlines.title: 정부 "단일 레버리지 ETF 개인 별 총투자 액 20 %로 제한 "
headlines.summary: 단일종목 상품 집중이 변동성·매도 압력 키웠다고 진단 과다호가부담금 확대·시장별 레버리지 배율 조정 대외 악재에 수급 불안 겹쳐…24시간 모니터링 가동 29일 정부서울청사에서 열린 긴급 시장상황점검회의가 열려 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부장관(가운데)을 비롯한 참석자들이 사진 촬영을 하고 있다.

headlines.title: 더 폭락한 단일종목 레버리지 … 배수 조정하고 투자한도 제한
headlines.summary: 정부, 추가대책 마련 급물살 이틀연속 폭락장에 출시 후 60% 이상 급락 홍콩식 가변 레버리지 도입 법적 근거 마련 목표배율 일별 조정에 투자액 20%내 제한 금투업계는 ‘리밸런싱 거래’ 장중으로 분산 30일 오전 서울 중구 우리은행 딜링룸 전광판에 코스피 지수가 전 거래일보다 287.07포인트 상승한 5950.31포인트를 기록하고 있다.

headlines.title: 코인 과세 폐지 청원 국회 계류 중인데 …" 예정대로 간다 " 못 박은 정부
headlines.summary: 구윤철 경제부총리 "가상자산 과세, 예정대로 내년부터 추진" 업계·야당 반발…"과세 인프라 여전히 미흡, 위축된 시장 더 죽는다" 비트코인 ⓒAFP=뉴스1 (서울=뉴스1) 황지현 최재헌 기자 박현영 블록체인전문기자 = 정부가 가상자산 과세를 예정대로 내년부터 시행하겠다는 방침을 공식화하면서 야당과 업계를 중심으로 반발이 커지고 있다.

headlines.title: 보유·거래 ‘ 이중 증세 ’… 세제로 ‘ 집값 진압 ’
headlines.summary: ■ 당정, 부동산 세제 최종 협의 공시가격 30억 이상 과세 강화 장특공제 한도 10억으로 제한 구윤철 경제부총리가 30일 오전 국회 의원회관에서 열린 세제개편관련 비공개 당정협의회 참석을 위해 회의실로 들어서고 있다.

headlines.title: 보유세 오를 때마다 전월세 올랐다
headlines.summary: 2021년 종부세 늘자, 서울 월세 11%↑ 서울 아파트 월세 평균 160만원 육박 늘어난 세금 세입자 전가 재현 우려 당정, 하반기 세제개편안 조율 나서 서울 아파트 평균 월세가 160만원에 육박한 가운데 정부가 고가주택과 다주택자를 중심으로 보유세를 강화하는 방안을 검토하면서 임대차시장에 미칠 영향에도 관심이 쏠리고 있다.

headlines.title: 집주인 ‘ 증여 고민 ’ 매수자 ‘ 급매 대기 ’… 거래 잠겼다
headlines.summary: 서초구 30억 이상 아파트 “稅 강화” 발표 이후 거래 無 세금 얼마나 오를까 다음 달 초 초고가 주택 보유세 부담을 늘리는 세제개편안이 발표되는 가운데 28일 시민들이 서울 시내 아파트 단지를 내려다보고 있다.  뉴시스 초고가 주택 세 부담 강화를 골자로 한 부동산 세제개편안 발표를 앞두고 규제 공포가 극에 달하면서 강남 등 핵심지 시장이 급랭하고 있다.

headlines.title: 정부, 美금리동결에 " 국내 경제·금융시장 영향 면밀 점검 "
headlines.summary: 거시경제금융회의…재경 차관·한은 부총재 등 참석 이형일 1차관, 거시경제금융회의 주재 (서울=연합뉴스) 이형일 재정경제부 1차관이 30일 서울 중구 은행회관에서 '거시경제금융회의'를 주재, 발언하고 있다. 2026.7.30 [재정경제부 제공. 재판매 및 DB 금지] photo@yna.co.

headlines.title: 美 연준 금리 동결 … 정부 " 정책금리 불확실성 지속 "
headlines.summary: 이형일 1차관, 거시경제금융회의 개최 고물가·중동 불안에 금리 전망 불투명 국제유가·글로벌 자금 흐름 면밀 점검 [서울=뉴시스] 미국 연방준비제도(Fed·연준)는 29일(현지시간) 기준금리를 3.50∼3.75%로 동결했다. 올해 들어 다섯 번째 금리 동결로, 연준은 중동 분쟁에 따른 높은 불확실성에도 미국 경제가 견조한 성장세를 이어가고 있다고 평가했다.

headlines.title: 한미 금리차 1%P 유지됐지만 한은 금리 ‘연속 인상’ 가시권 [미 금리 ...
headlines.summary: 美 장기국채 급등…韓 금융시장 영향권 韓 선제적 인상 가능성…성장도 뒷받침 7월 물가 관건, 근원물가 상승세에 주목 미국 연방준비제도(Fed·연준)의 금리 동결로 한미 금리차는 유지됐지만 한국은행의 금리 인상 기조에는 가속도가 붙고 있다.

headlines.title: 반도체 훈풍 에 제조업 체감경기 ‘껑충’…4년1개월 만에 최고
headlines.summary: 한국은행 7월 기업경기조사 발표…제조업 CBSI 103.2로 2022년 6월 이후 최고치 반도체·조선·방산 등 전방 산업 호조 영향… 비제조업, 물류비 상승에 두 달 연속 하락 평택항에 컨테이너가 쌓여있는 모습. 연합뉴스 반도체를 비롯한 주력 산업의 호조가 이어지면서 제조업 체감경기가 4년 1개월 만에 가장 높은 수준을 기록했다.

headlines.title: 제조업 UP - 비제조업 DOWN … 더 벌어진 체감경기
headlines.summary: ■ 한국은행 7월 기업경기조사 제조업 지수 4년1개월來 최고 비제조업 0.2P 하락한 95.2 반도체 호황에 제조업 체감경기가 4년 1개월 만의 최고 수준으로 개선됐지만, 비제조업은 오히려 뒷걸음질 친 것으로 나타났다. 수출 호조에 따른 온기가 제조업 전반으로 퍼지고 있는 반면 비제조업 경기는 후퇴하면서 제조업·비제조업 간 격차도 커지는 양상이다.

headlines.title: 보리 생산량 증가율 47%, 25년 만에 최고 … 가격 상승 영향
headlines.summary: 보리 생산량 13만6천t…6년 만에 가장 높아 마늘·양파도 생산량 소폭 증가…데이터처 조사 보리 촬영 고동선 (세종=연합뉴스) 이대희 기자 = 올해 보리 생산량 증가율이 25년 만에 가장 가팔랐던 것으로 집계됐다. 파종 시기 가격 상승에 따라 농가의 재배 선호도가 높아진 영향으로 분석된다.

headlines.title: 보리 생산량 47% 급증 … 마늘·양파도 소폭 증가
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 2026년 보리·마늘·양파 생산량조사 결과 보리, 가격 상승에 재배면적 확대 양파, 기상 호조로 단위면적 생산량 늘어 연도별 보리, 마늘, 양파 생산량 추이. 국가데이터처 제공 올해 보리 생산량이 전년보다 47.3% 증가한 13만 6천톤으로 집계됐다. 지난해 보리 가격 상승으로 재배면적이 크게 늘어난 데 따른 것이다.

key_headlines.title: US Federal Reserve Holds Rates Steady; Korea Bank Eyes Consecutive Rate Hikes
key_headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve maintained its benchmark rate at 3.50-3.75% for the fifth consecutive time on July 29, with three committee members dissenting and advocating for rate increases. This hawkish hold signals potential rate increases ahead, while the Bank of Korea is positioning itself for consecutive rate hikes amid strong domestic growth.

key_headlines.title: Manufacturing Sentiment Surges to 4-Year High on Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's manufacturing business sentiment index (CBSI) reached 103.2 in July, the highest level since June 2022, driven by strong performance in semiconductors, shipbuilding, and defense industries. This marks the strongest sentiment in over four years as major industries continue their robust recovery.

key_headlines.title: Government Pursues Dual Real Estate Tax Increases to Cool Housing Prices
key_headlines.summary: The government and ruling party finalized comprehensive real estate tax reforms including strengthened taxation on public land prices exceeding 3 billion won and limiting long-term ownership deductions to 1 billion won. These measures aim to suppress rising property prices through dual taxation on holdings and transactions.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Prices Rise for 77 Consecutive Weeks
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment prices increased 0.25% in the week of July 27, marking the 77th consecutive week of gains, though the pace of increases in both jeonse (deposit) and purchase prices slowed for the second consecutive week. External districts show accelerating buying activity as buyers rush to secure loans.

key_headlines.title: Microsoft Reports Strong AI-Driven Earnings But Gaming Segment Declines 10%
key_headlines.summary: Microsoft recorded quarterly revenue of 90 billion dollars and net profit of 35.8 billion dollars, up 18% and 31% year-over-year respectively, bolstered by AI business expansion. However, Xbox gaming segment revenue declined 10% due to both content/service and hardware sales declines amid restructuring costs.

sections.Hot Economy News: Manufacturing business sentiment in South Korea has reached a four-year high of 103.2 in July 2026, driven by strong performance across semiconductors, shipbuilding, and defense sectors. The US Federal Reserve maintained its benchmark rate at 3.50-3.75% for the fifth consecutive time, though three committee members dissented by voting for rate increases, signaling a more hawkish stance. The government is implementing comprehensive real estate tax reforms to control housing price inflation, including stronger taxation on high-value properties and limiting ownership deductions. Seoul apartment prices have continued their 77-week streak of increases, though the pace of gains has moderated in recent weeks. Korea's economy continues showing resilience with strong growth prospects, though inflation and international uncertainties remain key concerns.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea is positioned to accelerate consecutive rate hikes as the Korea-US rate differential remains at approximately 1 percentage point, with strong domestic economic growth supporting potential tightening measures. Q2 real GDP growth came in at 0.6% quarter-over-quarter and 3.7% year-over-year, exceeding the Bank of Korea's May forecast of 0.2% and supporting full-year growth targets above 3%. The government held a macro-financial meeting on July 30 to closely monitor impacts from US Federal Reserve policy decisions and Middle East geopolitical uncertainties. Core inflation trends will be critical in determining the timing and pace of Bank of Korea rate increases, with August inflation data expected to be particularly important. International oil prices and global capital flows are being closely monitored as key variables affecting domestic monetary policy decisions.
sections.Financial Markets: US long-term Treasury yields surged following the Federal Reserve's hawkish hold, causing significant turbulence in global financial markets with the Dow Jones index declining 2% amid oil price spikes. The Korean won weakened to the 1,430 won range per dollar, reflecting broader market volatility triggered by the FOMC decision and Middle East tensions. KOSPI index attempted recovery around the 6,000 level as Samsung Electronics shares gained momentum following positive semiconductor supply outlooks from major tech companies. Three FOMC members voted for rate increases, intensifying expectations for potential September rate hikes and causing market repricing across equity and fixed income segments. SK Hynix ADR and other semiconductor stocks showed notable volatility as investors reassess the trajectory of US monetary policy and its implications for tech earnings.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's semiconductor industry continues its strong momentum with major players like Samsung Electronics and Samsung SDI reporting robust earnings and expanding production capacity. Samsung SDI announced that its US LFP battery manufacturing line will begin cell production in October 2026 for energy storage solutions, supporting domestic EV battery expansion. Fitein, a commercial EV battery platform company, was selected for the 2026 Innovation Premier 1000 designation for its battery subscription and fast-charging solutions for commercial vehicles. Korean researchers at KAIST have developed breakthrough battery technology that addresses rapid charging heat limitations, enhancing EV battery performance and safety. The US is implementing strict import restrictions on Chinese robotics and related components citing national security concerns, creating potential opportunities for Korean manufacturers in alternative supply chains.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices rose for the 77th consecutive week to July 27, with a weekly increase of 0.25%, though the pace of gains in both jeonse and purchase prices decelerated for the second week in succession. Outer district areas like Jung-gu show accelerating buyer activity as purchasers rush to secure mortgage financing, with cumulative price increases in some areas like Seongbuk-gu reaching 10% year-to-date driven by redevelopment projects. The government is implementing comprehensive tax reforms including enhanced taxation on properties with public land prices exceeding 3 billion won and limiting long-term ownership deductions to 1 billion won to address price pressures. Major construction companies plan to supply approximately 23,000 units of large apartment complexes from August through year-end, reflecting continued strong new supply in the market. Commercial property vacancy rates have risen, creating financial pressure on small landlords unable to cover interest payments, signaling potential credit stress in the real estate sector if economic conditions deteriorate.
sections.International Economy: The Federal Reserve maintained its policy rate at 3.50-3.75% with three committee members dissenting in favor of rate increases, representing a more hawkish stance that is expanding market expectations for potential September rate hikes. Long-term US Treasury yields surged following the FOMC decision, causing significant repricing across global financial markets and triggering equity selloffs, particularly affecting the Dow Jones index. The Bank of Korea identified expansion of uncertainty related to US monetary policy and Middle East geopolitical developments as key risk factors for Korea's financial markets and economic stability. Elon Musk has resumed significant political contributions to Republican causes despite earlier claims of withdrawing from politics, potentially influencing US policy trajectories relevant to Korean exporters. Global capital flows are shifting in response to Fed policy expectations and Middle East tensions, with the dollar strengthening as a safe-haven asset while emerging market currencies face pressure.
sections.AI & Economy: Microsoft reported strong Q4 earnings growth of 18% in revenue and 31% in net profit, significantly exceeding market expectations and driving an 8% stock price increase, though this growth was heavily concentrated in AI infrastructure investment segments. Korean AI-related startups are showing strong momentum with Busan region new IT business formations increasing 48.6% year-over-year, reflecting the emergence of AI and digital transformation as new growth drivers for the startup ecosystem. Samsung Electronics and Samsung SDI are heavily investing in AI server components and MLCCs, with Samsung Electronics securing long-term supply contracts with over 10 major tech companies for advanced AI infrastructure products. The Bank of Korea is prioritizing AI-driven business transformation, launching customized AI education programs for new employees to enhance operational efficiency and practical skills. Rating agency Fitch has warned that AI-related market adjustments pose serious credit risks to the broader capital markets, as AI investment valuations have potentially outpaced underlying economic fundamentals and profit realization timelines.
sections.Others: LG Electronics reported record Q2 results with 23.8 trillion won in revenue and 1.58 trillion won in operating profit, benefiting from US export tariff refunds and strong B2B segment performance. Small and medium-sized manufacturers continued experiencing production contraction with output declining 3.7% year-over-year, though SME exports showed strength with a 12.7% increase, suggesting external demand resilience despite domestic production challenges. Commercial property vacancies have created severe financial distress for small landlords unable to cover interest payments, raising concerns about potential credit stress in the real estate financing sector. Mid-sized manufacturers in the Middle East conflict-affected industries are experiencing ongoing production disruptions, offsetting gains from strong export performance in other sectors. Samsung Electronics reported strong earnings with improved profit margins driven by semiconductor demand recovery and efficiency improvements, signaling positive momentum across Korea's major industrial conglomerates.
